title: Cross-Session Claim Ledger Row
description: One append-only ~/.agents/claims.jsonl row. Latest row for a (repo, lane) pair wins BY FILE POSITION — never by comparing ts values, which are advisory only (writer clocks may skew). This is advisory coordination, not a distributed lock. Schema evolution is additive-only: readers MUST tolerate unknown fields (additionalProperties true) and unknown status values (the anyOf escape), per the ledger adoption plan (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-21-galactic-protocol-followups.md, Slice C).

schema_version.description: Optional per-line schema version (e.g. "1.0"). Absent means 1.0. Enables additive evolution without a flag day across writer sessions.

ts.description: RFC 3339 UTC event timestamp. Advisory only — ordering authority is file position, not this value.

status.description: Known lifecycle values are enumerated; any other well-formed token is legal (enum-with-escape). 46 observed rows is too small a sample to freeze the vocabulary — readers treat unknown statuses as opaque and keep folding.

evidence.description: Commit SHA, file path, task ID, or null
